text: E tudo isto serve apenas para me humilhar, para me moer.

tr: What matters is you're getting divorced and you and I are getting married.

text: Nada que não se aguente.

tr: Please phone me before you come.

text: Eu não tenho de me desculpar. Ele está errado.

tr: And when you come in late and you call it a fucking club, you make us all look like a joke.

tr: Queen Mother has sent a message asking you to marry Devasena.

tr: At least I won't lose you for another 28 years.

text: - Sim, como se chamava?

tr: But you're not drowning, and that's something!

text: Gosto de me pôr à prova.

tr: I've been keeping a diary for three years.

text: Muito bem, aproximem-se, meninos.

text: Não importa o quanto a tua mãe não me aguente, ela está presa comigo.

tr: I want to eat something that I can only eat here.

tr: Only days ago Ragnar was asking if the war was over.

tr: Go ahead, make fun.

tr: Aren't those hospitals the ones they called "America's shame"?

tr: She told me that she got there first.

text: Estou biologicamente bloqueada dos controles.
tr: I'm biolocked out of the controls.

tr: Maybe he feels lonely because the kids started going to school.

tr: She suggested that I take him to the zoo.

tr: I got a job and I turned things around.

tr: "Rules, schmules," you say.

tr: Meet the feisty Rosalie.

tr: Whoever wants to marry her must first convince her father.

tr: Why did you go into the water?

text: Compreendo a sua posição, mas não sei se entende a minha.
tr: I do understand your position, but I don't know if you understand mine.

text: Tenho certeza de que Tom vai se recusar a fazer isso.
tr: I'm sure Tom will refuse to do that.

text: Nós sentamos nos fundos.
tr: We sat in the back.

text: Para mim, tanto faz que me chamem Tom ou Tommy.
tr: I'm fine with being called Tom or Tommy.

text: Ele se aproximou do garoto lendo um livro.
tr: He approached the boy reading a book.

text: Pergunto-te mais uma vez, como arranjas-te essa cicatriz?
tr: I ask you again, how did you get that scar?

text: O sol vai-se levantar em breve.
tr: The sun will come up soon.

text: A menos que me incomode.
tr: Unless he bugs me.

text: Vamos fazer isso com cuidado.
tr: Let's do this carefully.
